@errorLookupTimeout.description: Error shown where an address is read: the DNS lookup timed out.

errorPrivateAddress: The site's address isn't on the public internet.

@errorPrivateAddress.description: Error shown where an address is read: the host resolves to a private or local address.

errorUnsupportedEncoding: The page uses a text encoding that isn't supported.

@errorUnsupportedEncoding.description: Error shown where an address is read: the page's character set is unknown.

errorTooLarge: The page or image is too large.

@errorTooLarge.description: Error shown where an address is read: the response is over the size limit.

errorTimeout: The site took too long to respond.

@errorTimeout.description: Error shown where an address is read: the site stopped sending.

errorTooManyRedirects: The site redirected too many times.

@errorTooManyRedirects.description: Error shown where an address is read: more redirects than allowed.

errorHTTPSDowngrade: The site redirected from HTTPS to plain HTTP, so it wasn't followed.

@errorHTTPSDowngrade.description: Error shown where an address is read: a secure page redirected to an insecure one.

@errorInvalidClipID.description: Why a change was not saved, after errorNotSaved: a clip's identifier is malformed.

@errorInvalidArticleID.description: Why a change was not saved, after errorNotSaved: an article's identifier is malformed.

errorClipLength: A clip can be 1 to 20,000 characters long.

@errorClipLength.description: Why a change was not saved, after errorNotSaved: a clip is empty or too long.

@errorInvalidClipParagraph.description: Why a change was not saved, after errorNotSaved: a clip's place in the article is malformed.

@errorInvalidTextVersion.description: Why a change was not saved, after errorNotSaved: the version of the article's text a clip was made from is malformed.

@errorInvalidClipDate.description: Why a change was not saved, after errorNotSaved: a clip's creation time is malformed.

errorNoteTooLong: A note can be up to 4,000 characters long.

@errorNoteTooLong.description: Why a change was not saved, after errorNotSaved: a clip's note is too long.

@errorInvalidPosition.description: Why the reading position was not saved: it is malformed.

@errorInvalidItemID.description: Why a change was not saved, after errorNotSaved: the identifier of an article or writer is malformed.

@errorInvalidChange.description: Why a change was not saved, after errorNotSaved: no change was given.

errorInvalidFavoritesChange: This change to Favorites isn't valid.

@errorInvalidFavoritesChange.description: Why a change was not saved, after errorNotSaved: a change to many favorites at once is malformed.

errorInvalidBatchChange: This change to several articles isn't valid.

@errorInvalidBatchChange.description: Why a change was not saved, after errorNotSaved: a change to many articles at once is malformed.

errorWriterNameLength: A writer's name can be 1 to 40 characters long.

@errorWriterNameLength.description: Why renaming a writer was not saved: the name is empty or too long.

@errorUnsupportedChange.description: Why a change was not saved, after errorNotSaved: the library does not know the kind of change.

exploreNotListed: This article is no longer in Explore.

@exploreNotListed.description: Reader: an Explore article was asked for that Explore no longer lists.

@exploreFeaturedOn.description: Explore: a writer's or site's line when a recommender found it; name is the recommender, such as Hacker News or a gallery.

@errorLibraryCantOpen.description: Title of the dialog shown at launch when the library can't be opened; the app then quits.

@errorLibraryInUse.description: Title of the dialog shown at launch when another running Trie has the library open; the app then quits.

errorLibraryInUseDetail: A library can be open in only one Trie at a time.

@errorLibraryInUseDetail.description: Text of the dialog shown at launch when another running Trie has the library open.

@readerCalloutNote.description: Reader: the label of a NOTE callout in an article.

@readerCalloutTip.description: Reader: the label of a TIP callout in an article.

@readerCalloutImportant.description: Reader: the label of an IMPORTANT callout in an article.

@readerCalloutWarning.description: Reader: the label of a WARNING callout in an article.

@readerCalloutCaution.description: Reader: the label of a CAUTION callout in an article.

@kindLanding.description: Explore's kind of design work: landing pages.

@kindPortfolio.description: Explore's kind of design work: portfolio sites.

@kindMotion.description: Explore's kind of design work: motion, scroll effects and animation.

@kindType.description: Explore's kind of design work: typography and typefaces in use.

@kindBrand.description: Explore's kind of design work: brand identities, logos and packaging.

@exploreKinds.description: Accessible name of the row of kinds under Explore's design front page; no visible heading.

@favoritesWorkCount.description: Favorites: accessible name of a block of the map holding a kind's or a gallery's kept designs (and, with the articles' name, the block of articles), which zooms into it.

favoritesWorksCount: {count, plural, one {# work kept} other {# works kept}}

@favoritesWorksCount.description: Favorites: how many designs of a kind or a gallery are kept, at the head of their page.

@favoritesRemoveAllWorks.description: Menu item that removes all the kept designs of a kind or a gallery (always more than one).

favoritesRemovedWorksFrom: {count, plural, one {Removed # work from {name}} other {Removed # works from {name}}}

@favoritesRemovedWorksFrom.description: Notice after several kept designs of a kind or a gallery were removed; offers Undo.

@favoritesAllFrom.description: Favorites: under a writer's latest kept titles, the link to all of them on their page.

@favoritesArticles.description: Favorites: the name of the map's block of kept articles, shown when it is pointed at, and the accessible name of the writers' sheets inside it.

@favoritesCaptures.description: Favorites: the name of the map's block of captured pages (see capture), shown when it is pointed at, and the accessible name of the captures inside it.

@favoritesCaptureCount.description: Favorites: accessible name of the map's block of captured pages, which zooms into it.

@capture.description: Reader toolbar: the button that captures the page, a folder of its screens, text, pictures and fonts for one's own AI; and its accessible name. Also the feature's name.

@captureTip.description: Reader toolbar: tooltip of the Capture button before the page is captured.

@captureTakingTip.description: Reader toolbar: tooltip of the Capture button while the page is being captured or waits its turn.

@captureReadyTip.description: Reader toolbar: tooltip of the Capture button once the page is captured; pressing it opens the capture's card.

captureFailedTip: Not captured, open to see why

@captureFailedTip.description: Reader toolbar: tooltip of the Capture button once capturing the page failed; pressing it opens the capture's card, which says what happened and offers Try Again.

@captureIsland.description: Accessible name of the island at the top of the window holding the pages being captured and those just captured.

@captureHide.description: Capture island: the button at its right end, shown while it is pointed at, that sends the island away and what it holds into Favorites (what is being captured goes on there); its accessible name and tooltip.

@captureMovedOne.description: Announced to screen readers as the capture island, holding one page, goes into the Favorites tab. Echoes the button that did it.

captureMovedMany: {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} moved to Favorites

@captureMovedMany.description: Announced to screen readers as the capture island, holding several pages, goes into the Favorites tab.

@captureTakingAt.description: Announced after captureMovedOne or captureMovedMany while a page the island held is still being captured: how far it has come.

@captureTabTaking.description: Tooltip of the Favorites tab after the Favorites tab name and a middle dot, while a page moved there with the capture island is being captured: which page, and how far it has come, as under the tab.

@captureTakenNote.description: Under the Favorites tab's icon for a few seconds when a page finished while the island was in Favorites. Kept short: it sits under a 32 px tab.

@captureQueued.description: A capture's card and its place in Favorites: in place of how far it has come while it waits its turn. Kept short.

@captureNotTakenShort.description: A capture's place in Favorites, at its foot, and the first line of the note under the Favorites tab when a page could not be taken while the island was in Favorites. Kept short.

@captureWaiting.description: Capture island: accessible name of a page's thumbnail while it waits its turn.

@captureTaking.description: Capture island: accessible name of a page's thumbnail while it is being taken.

@captureReady.description: Capture island: accessible name of a page's thumbnail once it is captured.

@captureUsed.description: Capture island: accessible name of a page's thumbnail just after its brief was copied.

@captureNotTaken.description: Capture island: accessible name of a page's thumbnail that could not be taken.

@captureScreens.description: Capture card: how many screens of the page were taken, in the line under the site's name.

@captureImages.description: Capture card: how many of the page's pictures were saved, in the line under the site's name.

@captureFonts.description: Capture card: how many of the page's font files were saved, in the line under the site's name.

captureCopyTip: Copy a brief for AI with the materials' location

@captureCopyTip.description: Capture card: tooltip of the Copy button, which copies captureBrief: a short brief naming the page and the pack folder.

@captureBrief.description: Capture card: what Copy puts on the clipboard, to paste into the reader's own AI (Claude Code, Codex). The task comes first, bounded by the materials; page, source and materials line up; what the folder holds, how to use it and what it lacks are left to its README.

@captureReveal.description: Capture card: button that shows the pack's folder in Finder.

captureDidNotLoad: The page did not load. Check the network and try again.

@captureDidNotLoad.description: Capture card: what happened when the page could not be loaded.

captureRefused: The site would not show this page to the app. Try again in a while.

@captureRefused.description: Capture card: what happened when the site answered with a bot check or an error page.

captureFailed: This page could not be captured. Try again in a while.

@captureFailed.description: Capture card: what happened when taking the page failed for another reason.

@captureDone.description: Announced to screen readers when a page has been taken.

@captureDidFail.description: Announced to screen readers when taking a page failed.
